title: Applied CEO sees two good years ahead
text:
## 事件
- Applied Materials CEO Gary Dickerson表示，客户正提供两年甚至三年的设备需求展望，以确保产能扩张顺利，他预计芯片行业未来两到三年前景乐观。
- 他特别看好封装业务，称“如何连接计算组件”将成为半导体行业最高增长领域之一；Applied 预计今年芯片封装工具业务将增长50%。
- 尽管非AI市场疲软，部分预测称芯片市场今年将达1.5万亿美元、明年1.9万亿美元，但未来取决于AI能否实现投资回报。

## 影响
- 设备制造商提前分享长期需求，可能缓解供应链瓶颈，加速晶圆厂和封装产能建设。
- 封装环节的高增长预期或推动相关设备、材料及工艺需求上升，尤其先进封装对AI芯片性能至关重要。
- 若AI投资无法兑现ROI，Future Horizons等机构警告市场可能面临调整，对整体半导体周期构成下行风险。

## 标的线索
- 半导体设备板块（应用材料、泛林半导体、东京电子等，待核实）
- 先进封装相关公司（台积电、日月光、长电科技等，待核实）
- 中国市场需求占比下降但仍在30%，关注对国内设备/材料进口替代可能的影响（待核实）

## 待验证
- Applied 封装工具业务2026年实际增速是否达到50%以及后续订单趋势。
- 芯片市场1.5万亿美元/1.9万亿美元预测的具体来源及拆分（AI vs 非AI）。
- 非AI市场“lack-lustre”程度，以及AI资本开支能否持续支撑高速增长。

你是「资讯雷达」投研向改写助手。任务：把用户提供的一篇资讯压成可读的投研草稿。

硬性要求：
1. 严格用下面四个中文小节标题（Markdown ##），顺序固定，每节 1-4 条短句：
## 事件
## 影响
## 标的线索
## 待验证
2. 只客观陈述；不推荐买卖；不预测涨跌；不构成投资建议。
3. 「标的线索」只能写可能相关的公司/板块/主题，并标注「待核实」；没有则写「暂无明确标的线索」。
4. 「待验证」写需要交叉核对的事实或缺口；没有则写「暂无」。
5. 不要输出前后缀寒暄、不要编造文中不存在的数字。

Applied Materials CEO Gary Dickerson sees a rosy future for the chip industry for the next two, even three years. He said that device manufacturers are sharing their equipment demand outlooks for two years or more to ensure their capacity expansions proceed smoothly. “Our largest customers, they’re giving us more of the long term visibility, because they know there’s a certain lead time that’s needed, just like for them,” Dickerson said. “The pervasiveness of the computing and the compute demand is unprecedented,” he said, “this compute demand, I have very high confidence that this is going to increase at a tremendous rate for many years into the future.” Some forecasters are saying the chip market will hit $1.5 trillion this year and $1.9 trillion next year but it all depends on the AI market because the non-AI markets are lack-lustre. While Europe’s leading chip consultancy, Future Horizons, predicts a crash if AI can’t find ROI on its huge investments. Dickerson is particularly upbeat on the packaging sector. “How you connect computing components together … is going to be one of the most exciting and high-growth segments in the whole semiconductor industry,” he said Dickerson added. Applied earlier forecast that its chip packaging tool business will grow 50% this year. Applied generated 30% of its 2025 revenue from China – lower than 37% for 2024 – but with over 80% of the growth in wafer fab equipment coming from the leading-edge segment where China is not involved, the US ban on sales to China is not unduly concerning.
